## Close-out

Every `fail` has a disposition, and each was re-derived by an independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7) or rests on the commit that changed the behaviour:

```text
Extracted: #21057 · access-security.crud-permission-matrix · acceptance[0]
Extracted: #21331 · access-security.public-form-intake · acceptance[6]
Extracted: #21332 · automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract · acceptance[6]
Extracted: objectstack-ai/objectui#11326 · approvals.account-app-entry · acceptance[6]
Extracted: #21333 · api-backend.filter-comparand-conformance · outside the item's clauses
Extracted: #21334 · studio-authoring.view-authoring-live · outside the item's clauses
Extracted: objectstack-ai/objectui#11448 · records-forms.field-type-matrix · steps 4-5, no clause
```

The five stale / assertion-defect fails are re-pointed by draft PR #21339 (the re-point carrier, one history entry per item). This run re-judges all 19 items of #21056, so #21056 is superseded with nothing to carry forward.

### Product defects

| card | from | severity (verifier) | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| #21057 (existing, open) | crud-permission-matrix A1 | P2, fails closed | still reproduces at `617f25f8`; mechanism unchanged (seeded units carry `organization_id: null`) |
| **#21331** (new) | public-form-intake A7 | **P1, authorization** | detail withheld pending maintainer (RUNNER rule 2) |
| **#21332** (new) | packaged-flow-clone-contract A7 | major | the clone reaches no Studio surface; was FOLLOW-UPS §8 row D18, never filed; needs an owner decision (objectui rail vs objectstack packaging) |
| objectui#11326 (existing) | account-app-entry A7 | console | fixed upstream in objectui `d0fba91aa`, **not in the 17.6.0 pin** `31971ff1e28f`; a later pin bump carries it |
| **#21333** (new) | found in filter-comparand-conformance | major, silent wrong rows | a string comparand on a boolean field answers 200 with wrong rows (`$ne "true"` returns the true row; `?f=true` / `?f=false` both 0 rows) |
| **#21334** (new) | found in view-authoring-live | medium, integrity | a view container's bare `list` on another package's object replaces its packaged default on the object door; the by-name read disagrees |
| **objectui#11448** (new) | found in field-type-matrix | major, console | a `json` field shows `[object Object]` in the edit form and saves as a string |

### Stale clauses (the docs PR)

Draft PR #21339 re-points the five stale / assertion-defect clauses and retires three expected-fail notes 17.6.0 has made pass (subflow remedy, clone durability, write-door parity); each history entry cites the changing commit.

### Partial-coverage gaps (named, not dropped)

- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` A7 readonly half — no readonly column is settable over HTTP on the stock seed.
- `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` A2 "connects" — no real Postgres / MySQL / Mongo in the sandbox.
- `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` A6 member half — the clause's plain member never reaches Setup (`setup.access`); a persona with `setup.access` and without `manage_metadata` (e.g. `organization_admin`) renders the refusal exactly.
- `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` A6 — `blocked(dependency #21158)`: 17.6.0's deny baseline gives anonymous callers no channel to a permission set yet.

### Checklist-accuracy findings (not in #21339; for the checklist owner)

1. **Planned items behind a shipped capability:** `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` and `records-forms.picklist-org-append` are still `status: planned`, although shared picklists shipped in 17.6.0 (`addbbf0` #20823, `88b484e` #21047). They need steps and acceptance authored and a passing run before promotion (README "Promotion is earned").
2. `access-security.rls-both-sides` A6 still calls itself the "standing expected-fail probe"; it holds since `99398542` (#21104). The text needs a non-disclosing update; `showcase-invoice-seed-isolation.dogfood.test.ts` is a candidate `automated.ref`.
3. `access-security.write-path-guards` step 6 / A7: one mixed batch shows both outcomes only with `options.continueOnError: true` (default stops at the first failing row, `NOT_ATTEMPTED` after). N2: name `packages/objectql/src/engine-insert-static-readonly-strip.test.ts` in `automated.ref`.
4. `access-security.owd-sharing-matrix` step 4: `showcase_invoice` and `showcase_project` require `account`.
5. `access-security.audit-log-browser` step 5: at this Console pin the page `/apps/setup/system/audit-log` ("Audit Log Browser") HAS an Action select that sends `$filter`; the Recent / Writes / Auth / Config tabs belong to the separate `sys_audit_log` object view. The 405 lists `get, list, aggregate, search, export`.
6. `access-security.public-form-intake` step 6: the anonymous page is `/_console/f/contact-us` (`/forms/contact-us` in the console is the authenticated form). A2: an anonymous submit lands `owner_id: null`, not "server-stamped". Step 7 names no unpublish route.
7. `access-security.packaged-flow-write-door-parity` (observation): the layered read of the packaged flow reports `lock: none, editable: true` while both write doors refuse 403.
8. `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` step 3: the principal-bound line logs at info — needs `--log-level info`. MCP `query_records` caps `limit` at 50.
9. `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix`: the named seeded personas cannot drive the secured leg; use `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`. Step 6's non-array shape refusal carries no worked example.
10. `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` A2: the enabled-control 400 code is `VALIDATION_ERROR`, not `VALIDATION_FAILED`.
11. 17.6.0 notes, "The engine's aggregate judges…": the wire `INVALID_FIELD` envelope carries `{error, code, field, object}` only — not `fields` / `param`.
12. `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable` step 6: the activation-ledger boot line is info-level (`OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`).
13. `automation.flow-toggle-kill-switch`: `showcase_urgent_task_alert` is not "the only record_change flow" (8 are).
14. `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` A8: `sys_metadata_activation` is 403 for a plain member, not "open".
15. `integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle`: sqlite drafts take `config.filename` (17.6.0 refuses `file`); migrate-credential answers `result.status` `already-bound` / `migrated` / `refused`, not `action`; the list's health field is `status` + `statusReason`.
16. `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` A7 / N6: these doors never serve a mask — they omit the key and list it in `redactedConfigKeys`. Observation for the maintainer: PATCHing the literal `••••••••` as a turso `encryptionKey` stores the literal (admin door and meta door) — matters only if a client echoes a rendered mask.
17. `dashboards.cube-query` A1: the meta body is `data[]`, no `cubes` key. `dashboards.global-filters-rescope` A6 names `kpi_at_risk`, which opts out by design (#7568) — the composing tile is `kpi_awaiting_review`. `dashboards.dataset-report-authoring` A6: the two joined blocks show different measures, so totals partition per measure only. `dashboards.strict-widget-rejects-stray-keys` step 5: the browser door that can emit a stray key is the metadata editor's Source tab. D2 needs a writable-package recipe (`duplicate` of the showcase → 422 DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE).
18. `records-forms.field-type-matrix` A6: `f_tree` targets `showcase_field_zoo` (not `showcase_category`); autonumber is not on the edit form by design; Edit lives under More actions; steps 4–5 have no clause (objectui#11448 shows one is needed). The `qa-contributor-bound-member` recipe writes `sys_user_position.position` (a name).
19. `studio-authoring.first-run-loop`: buttons read "Save as draft" / "Publish all". `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` step 2: a standalone view name must be dotted `<object>.<key>` (422 `invalid_format`), columns must be real fields (`title`), and step 8's surface is the metadata editor. `studio-authoring.custom-page-source-tiers` step 8: since `b531c7b` (#20852) a faulted html page exists only as a draft — its compile panel is in the page editor preview.
20. `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` step 1: `pnpm test:smoke` runs every spec in `e2e/`, not only the pin — name the file.
21. `approvals.account-app-entry`: the persona must own the invoice through the TEXT field `owner` (= its email) for the contributor RLS to admit its PATCH.
22. **Release notes:** `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx` "Known console issues at this pin" lists three issues but not the zh-CN (region-tagged locale) built-in catalogue gap (objectui#11326, fix `d0fba91aa` not in the pin).

Environment blockers are recorded in the run body; nothing further to extract.
